title: hieracium cochlearioides subsp. pseudoglanduliferum
intro: Hieracium cochlearioides subsp. pseudoglanduliferum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. The plant is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and pain, due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for therapeutic actions such as reducing swelling and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, there is limited research on the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of Hieracium cochlearioides subsp. pseudoglanduliferum, and more studies are needed to confirm its effects.
